'''Kazuya Nakai''' (Japanese: '''中井和哉''' ''Nakai Kazuya'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}. He was born on November 25, 1967 in {{wp|Hyōgo Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}.

==Pokémon roles==
Nakai started work during the middle of the [[original series]], voicing [[Character of the day|characters of the day]]. However, in {{aniseries|DP}}, he started voicing a recurring character, [[Nando]].
